aiContract.selectionPolicy: Use full plain H7 media or two-line detail product radio button. Every operational call needs the existing radiogroup wrapper with an accessible name and >=2 unique nonempty values; alone the specimen is presentation-only. 当前《新文件》仅核实Radio结算插槽边界；OptionSelector独立规范未定位，保留本地兼容范围，不标为全族MG通过。 颜色与服务已定位Tag常规属性/配件属性；颜色复用Select下拉，服务复用原生Checkbox。仅PC，不沿本地草案的Radio/24px图/M横向行。

identity.rule: media/product retain named radiogroup and unique values. color uses Tag PC trigger + existing Select single listbox. service uses Tag PC accessory + native Checkbox. These four current call shapes have separate semantics and allowed content; no page style overrides.

groupAssembly.rule: Wrapper is page assembly using the existing Preview class, not a new variant. Groups are independent and options cannot be nested groups.

locked: Plain H7 media or compact SKU/price product structure; source example retained
Current reusable runtime and shared CSS

behavior.group: Existing .ds-option-selector-group[role=radiogroup] required; initialization makes first enabled option tabbable if none selected. Click and arrows select once and emit ds:option-selector-change with value/label. Groups independent; no submission or navigation.
behavior.disabled: Native disabled option is cleared and skipped; current runtime also ignores synthetic disabled keyboard events.
behavior.keyboard: Arrow directions wrap; Home/End select boundaries. Enter/Space rely on native button activation and require browser evidence.
behavior.initialization: New current runtime uses a document guard to prevent duplicate delegates. Load timing supports DOMContentLoaded; no public insertion API. Do not co-load legacy and current scripts.
behavior.scope: Current PC media/product compatibility, Tag color dropdown and Tag accessory calls are available. Payment-brand, other source sizes, M/Pad and backend requests remain outside current call scope.
behavior.nativeStateGuard: Current native :disabled guards inherited fieldset; disabled changes resync tabstops without changing selection, and new choice clears previously disabled selection. Browser proof pending.
behavior.availability: Native disabled/fieldset, hidden or ARIA-disabled ancestors block synthetic selection and remove all unavailable tabstops while preserving previously committed state. Re-enable restores one available tabstop. Composing arrows do not select.
behavior.groupOwnership: Nearest radiogroup owns its options. Nested groups and dynamically inserted groups have independent state/tabstops; initialization runs once per group and subsequent availability sync does not clear prior selection.
behavior.serviceCheckbox: PC service is source Tag accessory + actual Checkbox(sm),264×80/64px image, native label activation. Existing M row specimen is not admitted.
behavior.finiteProduct: 当前精确调用采用规范页已有SKU+价格紧凑项；原Address/Shipping/Payment演示不作为商品选型依据，结算基础互斥项使用Radio/bordered-detail。
behavior.sourceConfiguration: color uses existing Select keyboard/outside/Escape/focus and ds:select-change(values,labels); Tag swatch follows selected data-color. service uses genuine Checkbox input and native change/disabled/Space. Host owns product/data requests; not a checkout/cart backend.

options.rule: 2..24 unique options; one initially selected, paired IDs, safe six-digit data-color business values only.
